mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a continuous signal where the level of FEDFUNDS is the primary driver.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 9.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5% and SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) exceeds 90 and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 130000, it indicates a robust economy with expanding industrial output and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met simultaneously.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 90 and PAYEMS > 130000 and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates and increased risk appetite. This mechanism is active only during the specified regime.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate stronger residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The level of HOUST is used as a continuous signal without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: HOUST > 500 and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600, it signals strong residential market activity that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is activated only when HOUST crosses above 600.
failure_condition: HOUST > 600 and SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher manufacturing production (INDPRO) indicates robust industrial activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The level of INDPRO is used as a continuous signal without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 90 and SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) exceeds 92.5, it signals accelerating industrial output that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is activated only when INDPRO crosses above 92.5.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 92.5 and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
